themes_detail.label: Standing Water / Drainage Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Standing water complaints spiked to 4 this week versus 0.4 weekly average over 8 weeks (967% increase, z-score 5.21), suggesting acute drainage failures or flooding in Tottenville/Great Kills that demand immediate infrastructure investigation.
evidence: 4 standing water complaints filed this week vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (967% spike)
Z-score of 5.21 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Correlates with Arden Heights Woods Stream Restoration project currently in public review—suggests pre-existing drainage infrastructure problems
reporting_angles: Canvass affected blocks to document flooding; interview residents about basement water, street pooling, and property damage
Cross-reference 311 complaint locations with city stormwater maps and DCP's Arden Heights restoration scope—is the project addressing this or ignoring it?

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Surge
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints jumped to 12 this week, up 284% from 3.1 weekly average (z-score 4.38), signaling a potential widespread pest outbreak that may correlate with industrial waste spike and sanitation gaps.
evidence: 12 rodent complaints this week vs. 3.1 weekly average (284% increase, z-score 4.38)
Simultaneous spike in Industrial Waste complaints (3 this week vs. 0.2 avg, 1100% increase) suggests unsecured waste attracting pests
Missed Collection complaints (377 total over 90 days) indicates ongoing sanitation issues that enable rodent habitat
reporting_angles: Interview DOHMH or Pest Control about whether this district is flagged for rodent activity; request rat inspection map data
Investigate which industrial sites or waste facilities in the area are improperly stored; cross-reference with 311 industrial waste complaints

themes_detail.label: Industrial Waste Violations
themes_detail.summary: Industrial waste complaints hit 3 this week versus 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35), indicating potential illegal dumping, hazardous material mishandling, or industrial non-compliance in a district with active industrial zoning applications.
evidence: 3 industrial waste complaints this week vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% increase, z-score 6.35)
South Shore Industrial Center land use application is currently filed and in early review stages—suggests active industrial development
Correlation with rodent spike (12 complaints this week) suggests waste is accumulating unsecured
reporting_angles: FOIL DEP violation records and DEC citations for industrial sites in Tottenville/Great Kills over past 6 months; identify repeat offenders
Examine South Shore Industrial Center application details: what waste streams, storage methods, and environmental reviews are proposed?

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Shortage
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests surged to 4 last week versus 0.5 weekly average (700% increase, z-score 7.0), suggesting residents perceive inadequate public trash infrastructure that may be driving dirty conditions and illegal dumping.
evidence: 4 litter basket requests last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 7.0)
Dirty Condition complaints total 347 over 90 days—suggests ongoing cleanliness gaps that basket requests are trying to address
May correlate with illegal dumping and industrial waste spike
reporting_angles: Map litter basket requests against current basket locations; identify neighborhoods with gaps
Interview Sanitation about capital budget for new baskets in this district and timeline for installation

themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Park rules violation complaints jumped to 3 last week versus 0.2 weekly average (1100% increase, z-score 6.35), suggesting disorder, encroachment, or misuse in public parks that warrants patrol and programming review.
evidence: 3 park rules violation complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Arden Heights Woods Stream Restoration is in public review—suggests park infrastructure projects may be underway, creating enforcement gaps
Possible correlation with bike/roller/skate spike 2 weeks ago (12 complaints vs. 3.4 avg)
reporting_angles: Identify which parks generated complaints; interview Parks Enforcement about staffing and recent violations
Assess whether Stream Restoration construction is limiting park access or enabling misuse
